stage: 4 of 5: score alignment and justified model comparison

hypotheses.lstm_endpoint: Endpoint label may be diluted by five-day mean error. Preserve full-window reconstruction loss, architecture, optimizer, inputs and background-window fit. Score last day only; select epoch/threshold on inner calibration using the same ties.
hypotheses.hist_gradient_boosting: RF signal on daily tabular aggregates and persistently weak reconstruction separation justify one supervised shallow boosting baseline; this is not proof that LSTMs cannot work. Compare directly with supervised RF, not as equal-supervision replacement for unsupervised LSTM/IF.

population: original primary train only; reuse all four feature policies and exact step-2/3 preparations, groups, roles, window membership, endpoint IDs and targets; no new preprocessing fit or cohort changes
unchanged: seed42, outer142, inner242+fold, labels, all-background LSTM windows, optimization loss mean MSE over all five days/features, hidden32, Adam0.001, batch128, max10epochs/patience5, existing percentile grids and F1/recall/lowerFPR/lowerthreshold/earliest-tied-epoch rules
reporting: all 24 new candidates and 36 frozen controls, all folds including regressions/zero recall
within-fold PR/ROC AUC, precision/recall/F1/FPR/confusion/support; macro mean/sampleSD/min/max; paired endpoint-vs-window and HGB-vs-RF differences within the same feature policy
complete pooled OOF decisions and scenario recall; no pooling of scores from separately fitted folds for PR/ROC AUC
timing, exact saved numerical inputs/windows/scores/decisions/checkpoints/thresholds, source/config/environment hashes and assessment/test read guards
no automatic winner/default replacement or extra trials selected from outer metrics
limits: Exploratory repeated development comparisons after previous validation/final exposure; one model seed and dependent folds; no independent confirmation. HGB/RF use positive labels in model fitting, LSTM/IF do not. A poor tested LSTM-AE is not proof that every recurrent model is unsuitable.
test_policy: No original primary validation/test scoring or prepared-test reads. Daily source is co-located and verified before filtering primary train. Previous consumed CERT test does not become independent.
